content.value_statement: Influencer teams need defensible ROI numbers from mixed spend and results data. This skill calculates returns, benchmarks efficiency, and prepares a stakeholder summary.
actual_capabilities: Calculates direct ROI, profit, and ROAS from investment and revenue inputs.
Estimates earned media value from impressions, engagements, CPM, and CPE assumptions.
Compares CPM, CPC, CPA, CAC, and related metrics against campaign benchmarks.
Models attributed revenue across first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and position-based methods.
Projects LTV-based ROI using new customers, average LTV, and spend.
Ranks influencer and tier-level ROI for budget allocation decisions.
limitations: Results depend on the accuracy of the spend, revenue, and performance data supplied.
EMV outputs are directional estimates, not audited financial value.
The skill does not build a full presentation or written report.
Live platform data requires user-provided exports or available connectors.

use_cases.title: Campaign ROI Review
use_cases.description: Calculate ROI, ROAS, profit, and efficiency metrics after an influencer campaign ends.

use_cases.title: Budget Defense
use_cases.description: Turn campaign spend and revenue data into clear numbers for finance or leadership review.

use_cases.title: Creator Portfolio Analysis
use_cases.description: Compare ROI by influencer and tier to guide future creator investment decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Calculate Basic ROI
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with spend, revenue, and reach.
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate influencer ROI for a campaign with $25,000 spend, $72,000 revenue, and 2.1 million reach.

prompt_templates.title: Compare ROI Methods
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request across direct revenue, EMV, and LTV.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare direct ROI, EMV, and LTV-based ROI for this campaign using my spend and results table.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Attribution Models
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with multiple customer touchpoints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Model attributed revenue using first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and position-based attribution for this influencer campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Build Executive ROI Summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for leadership-ready numbers and recommendations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a stakeholder ROI summary with benchmark status, influencer-level ROI, CVI readiness, and three investment recommendations.

output_examples.input: A campaign spent $25,000, generated $72,000 revenue, and reached 2.1 million people.
output_examples.output: The skill reports $47,000 profit, 188% ROI, 2.88:1 ROAS, estimated EMV, cost efficiency metrics, and a performance assessment.

output_examples.input: A team provides creator spend, revenue, conversions, new customers, and repeat purchase assumptions.
output_examples.output: The skill ranks creators by ROI and ROAS, compares CPA and CAC, estimates LTV impact, and recommends budget shifts.

output_examples.input: A campaign has multiple creator touchpoints before purchase.
output_examples.output: The skill compares attribution models, explains revenue differences, and recommends the model that fits the buyer journey.

best_practices: Provide the complete spend breakdown, including fees, production, products, tools, and paid amplification.
Separate hard revenue from estimated media value so stakeholders can see each return type clearly.
State benchmark sources and attribution assumptions before using the results for budget decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not treat EMV as cash revenue or audited profit.
Do not compare creators without normalizing for spend, audience size, and campaign role.
Do not use LTV-based ROI without clear retention, repeat purchase, and average LTV assumptions.

faq.question: What data do I need to use this skill?
faq.answer: You need campaign spend, revenue or conversions, reach, impressions, engagements, clicks, and any LTV assumptions in scope.

faq.question: Can it calculate ROAS?
faq.answer: Yes. It divides revenue by total investment and explains the return generated for each dollar spent.

faq.question: Does it calculate earned media value?
faq.answer: Yes. It estimates EMV from impression and engagement assumptions, then flags the result as directional.

faq.question: Can it compare attribution models?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares first-touch, last-touch, linear, time-decay, and position-based attribution methods.

faq.question: Does it produce a full slide report?
faq.answer: No. It prepares ROI numbers and a summary block, but a separate report skill should build the final deck.

faq.question: Is it useful without live integrations?
faq.answer: Yes. You can paste campaign tables manually and still receive the full calculation workflow.
